title: Program Crashes when trying to load a project
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot v. 4.4.1 - Vulkan (Forward+) - CPU AMD 9800x3D - GPU AMD Radeon 7900XT - Driver 25-10-25-01-25072a-417878C-AMD-Software-Adrenaline-Edition - Vulkan API Version 1.4.315 - Vulkan Driver Version 2.0.353

### Issue description

This happened with even a freshly made project that was set to Forward+. And when I went in and changed the rendering preset to Compatibility in the project.godot file, it loaded but still showed that it was in Forward+. I tried changing to Compatibility, then back, and then it won't open anymore.

### Steps to reproduce

Unsure. The last new project I made did it automatically, but when trying to make a new one to use as the MRP, it opens fine.

My project has a lot of shaders and I think it may be related, but the fact it was happening with a fresh project makes me think otherwise.
